name: tpl-existence-1-nogoal
task: Flip the switch on the wall.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task commands the switch to be flipped, so a hard Existence(switch_toggled) is the right template and priority. switch_toggled is declared in the environment and the machine's final state is reached when it happens.

texts: Toggle the wall switch at least once during the episode
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, switch_toggled, u1) -> 11
